EnglishInfo.Description:
Odalys Prestige Apart'Hotel L'Eclose is a brand-new holiday complex, situated in an ideal location in Alpe d'Huez. There’s no need to go far to find great shops and restaurants: everything you will need is on the ground floor of the building. The nearest ski lift is only 100 metres away and the centre is 500 metres away.

With its stylish architecture that blends in perfectly with its surroundings, the Odalys Prestige Apart'Hotel l'Eclose is a charming mix of modern and traditional. You can choose from a range of luxury apartments to suit your needs. All of the bedrooms are spacious and comfortable, furnished with large, high-quality beds. You will even have your own useful kitchenette, so you can prepare delicious meals with ease. To ensure that you can fully relax whilst on holiday, there will be a daily cleaning service, so you can enjoy fresh towels and sheets. The complex also features a spa where you can enjoy a soothing massage or beauty treatment, and an indoor, heated swimming pool.
EnglishInfo.Name: Prestige Odalys L'Eclose - Apart'Hotel
